description: Defines the HttpConnection class and its nested classes ReadIOBuffer and QueuedWriteIOBuffer, which manage HTTP connection data buffers, socket, and WebSocket association.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Manages an HTTP connection including socket, buffers, and WebSocket.

classes.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer for reading data from the connection.

classes.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer for queued write data to the connection.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the read buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::SetCapacity
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the read buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::IncreaseCapacity
methods.description: Increases buffer capacity if within limit.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::DidRead
methods.description: Updates buffer after data is read.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::GetSizeToWrite
methods.description: Returns size of data to write.
